subject: Post-call recap & proposed telemetry success plan for BrightLane trial
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@brightlane.io>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@brightlane.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-20T14:12:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed telemetry success plan for BrightLane trial

Hi Priya / Liam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the trial scoped and scheduled.

Key objectives we heard today:
- Validate Redwood’s end-to-end observability for your production-like workload (latency, tail p95/p99, token cost).
- Verify trace-level request attribution so you can correlate user action -> model calls -> downstream system events.
- Confirm log export and retention (S3) for audit/compliance.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
1) Dashboards: Real-time latency + cost per route, per-model token breakdown, and p95/p99 latency trend.
2) Tracing: 90% of production requests show full trace (ingest + model runtime) within 30s of request.
3) Logs: Structured request logs exported to BrightLane S3 bucket daily with 30d retention for the trial.
4) Alerts: Two threshold alerts (p95 latency > 600ms, error rate > 1%) routed to your OnCall.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Mar 24: 1-hour kickoff (scope, test data, access).
- Week 1 (Mar 24–31): Instrumentation + dashboard templates + trace ingestion test.
- Week 2: Real workload run, verify exports and alerts.
- Week 3: Final review, the quality scorecard, and rollout recommendation.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood runtime/tracing: Aditya Rao
- Dashboards/alerting: Grace O'Connor
- Trial coordination & pricing lead: Lauren Bishop
- BrightLane point of contact: Priya Desai

Open questions for you (so we can finalize the kickoff agenda):
- Can you confirm a test S3 bucket + IAM role for log export or do you need Redwood to push sample logs to a shared location?
- Expected candidate routes for the evaluation (top 3 API routes by volume).
- Any regulatory constraints on storing traces/keys beyond 30 days?

I've attached a short one-pager with the proposed POC scope and a sample metrics schema. If the above looks good we'll lock the kickoff for Mar 24 — proposed 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
Attachments: brightlane-proposed-poc-scope.pdf (1 page), sample-metrics-schema.csv
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@brightlane.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Turner <liam.turner@brightlane.io>
Date: 2027-03-20T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed telemetry success plan for BrightLane trial

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful and mostly aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) S3/export: We can provide an S3 bucket and will set up an IAM role for Redwood to write. Will share details before the kickoff.
2) Trace ingestion: Our stack uses OpenTelemetry; can Redwood ingest OTLP over gRPC or do you prefer a push adapter? We want to ensure spans include our internal request_id for correlation.
3) Retention: 30d retention for traces/logs during the trial is fine, but we need to confirm we can export raw traces off-platform for audit later.
4) Duration: We were thinking a 3-week trial, aligned with your week-by-week plan — ok.
5) Pricing question: Please include expected delta pricing if we need Dedicated capacity during the trial for stable p95 numbers (ballpark monthly).

Also, our top 3 candidate routes for initial evaluation: /api/generate-summary, /api/extract-insights, /api/rerank.

We'll confirm the kickoff time if 10:00 PT works for our team.

— Priya
Dir. Platform Engineering, BrightLane
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: --
Date: 2027-03-21T09:00:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap & proposed telemetry success plan for BrightLane trial — engineering asks

Forwarding Priya's notes. TL;DR: BrightLane will provide S3 + OTLP traces (OpenTelemetry). They want ability to correlate their request_id through spans and want to export raw traces after trial. Also asked about dedicated capacity pricing for the trial window.

Action items / owners I propose: 
- Aditya: own trace ingestion adapter + verification with OTEL samples; confirm whether we can accept OTLP/gRPC or need a push adapter; verify spans keep request_id as attribute. Target: test ingestion by Mar 26.
- Grace: create dashboard templates (latency distribution, token cost per route, errors by model) and wire two alert rules. Target: dashboard ready for Mar 24 kickoff.
- Lauren: confirm pricing guidance for Dedicated trial option and own kickoff scheduling + docs share.

Notes on export/retention: we need to confirm legal/audit — engineering: can Redwood produce a raw trace export to S3 as a newline-delimited JSON that BrightLane can download post-trial? If not possible, propose alternative (daily export, archive).

Please reply with confirmations and any blockers by EOD so I can respond to Priya. Deal: DL-2027-0934.

Karthik
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@brightlane.io>, Liam Turner <liam.turner@brightlane.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T15:22:00Z
Subject: BrightLane trial kickoff confirmed — Mar 24 10:00 PT + kickoff pack

Hi Priya / Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround. 10:00 PT on Mar 24 works for us; calendar invite sent. 

Quick summary of what we'll deliver during the trial (short kickoff pack below):
- 3-week trial (Mar 24–Apr 14) with week-by-week checkpoints.
- Instrumentation checklist: OTLP samples, S3 write access (IAM role), sample payloads for the three routes you listed.
- Dashboards: latency (p50/p95/p99), token usage by route, cost estimate, error breakdown, and a trace sampling view.
- Export: daily raw trace + structured log export to your S3 bucket in newline JSON (retained 30d). We'll also provide a final export archive at trial end.
- Alerts: p95 latency alert (600ms), error rate (1%), and a custom alert you request during Week 1.

Owners (confirmed):
- Redwood trace ingestion + export: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.ai)
- Dashboards & alerts: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.ai)
- Trial coordination & pricing: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.ai) / Karthik Iyer

Pricing note: for the kickoff we'll include ballpark Dedicated trial pricing (daily burn estimate) and a short appendix with options (hosted burst, short-term dedicated). Lauren will follow up with exact numbers before Mar 24.

Kickoff pack resources:
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefBrightLane-POC
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BL-1245
- Attachments: brightlane-proposed-poc-scope.pdf, sample-metrics-schema.csv

Next steps for Priya/Liam before kickoff:
1) Share S3 bucket name + IAM role ARN.
2) Send sample payloads for the three routes (or allow Redwood to replay captured traffic).
3) Confirm any compliance/export constraints on traces.

Looking forward — see you Wednesday.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: brightlane-proposed-poc-scope.pdf (1p), sample-metrics-schema.csv
